task_instance: Scaffold a minimal Cloudflare Worker using the stable @cloudflare/sandbox package (matching the skill's gate check and minimal shape), define a Sandbox container via Dockerfile + wrangler.jsonc, run it locally with `wrangler dev`, and verify `sandbox.exec()` actually executes a shell command inside the containerized sandbox and returns stdout/exitCode as documented.
evidence: Created project at sandbox-demo/ with: src/index.ts (getSandbox/proxyToSandbox/Sandbox from '@cloudflare/sandbox', sandbox.exec(...)), Dockerfile (FROM cloudflare/sandbox:0.12.10), wrangler.jsonc (containers + durable_objects binding + nodejs_compat flag). Installed @cloudflare/sandbox@0.12.10 (confirmed stable, non-@next line) and wrangler@4.141.0 via npm. `npx tsc --noEmit` passed against installed stable types with no errors, matching the skill's minimal-shape contract. Ran `npx wrangler dev --port 8788` locally (no Cloudflare account/login required for local dev): wrangler used Docker to build the sandbox container image (docker.io/cloudflare/sandbox:0.12.10) and pulled cloudflare/proxy-everything, started a local Durable Object + container, then served the Worker. curl to the local endpoint returned: {"stdout":"sum=4\nLinux cf65df0dee95 6.18.44-fc-v37 ... x86_64 GNU/Linux","exitCode":0,"success":true} — confirming sandbox.exec() genuinely executed a command inside the running container and returned buffered stdout/exitCode per the skill's contract section 2. (An earlier attempt with `python3 -c "print(2+2)"` returned exitCode 127 because python3 isn't in the base image -- not a skill/runtime blocker, just missing tooling in that particular container image; switched to a shell command available in the base image to verify the exec pipeline itself.) Files: /tmp/claude-0/.../sandbox-demo/src/index.ts, /tmp/claude-0/.../sandbox-demo/Dockerfile, /tmp/claude-0/.../sandbox-demo/wrangler.jsonc.
